text:
ci-bot: [ALERT] main pipeline -> smoke-tests step FAILED (exit 1). Triggered by merge commit abc123 by @maria. Job: https://ci.internal/redwood/9087

maria: seeing it, i'm on it. i merged the documentation patch earlier, but this looks like a runtime failure not docs.

jake: rerunning the smoke job now (rerun id 9087-2) to confirm flake or regression.

brian: fyi i noticed allocator churn in the last green before that merge, could be related to kvalloc changes in #456. @maria any overlap?

maria: no direct overlap, my PR was docs-only but it pulled in a minor dep update via CI config. i'll try a local reproduce with the same docker image.

carla: i can take a look if you need; tagging @maria in case you're already deep.

jake: rerun finished — still failing at smoke-tests/kvalloc-smoke (same stack).

maria: ouch. stack trace from the job logs:

```
kvalloc: allocation failed: cudaMalloc returned OOM
  at alloc.cc:142
  at kv_cache.cc:87
  at smoke_runner.cc:54
```

maria: i'm pulling the full docker image and running the exact smoke command locally to see if it's reproducible.

brian: if it's OOM, could be a scheduler change or a default batchsize bump in the runner image. did anyone change MEM_LIMIT in the smoke CI matrix recently?

jake: quick diff: .ci/smoke.yaml had default_batch: 1 -> 2 in last pipeline PR (id 732). that was a config-only change merged a few hours before the docs PR.

maria: good catch. @jake can you try re-running with BATSHARD=1 override?

jake: started a manual job with BATSHARD=1 (manual-9087-debug).

oncall-bot: Reminder: if this blocks main for > 15 min escalate to oncall rotation.

carla: manual-9087-debug is green so far — kvalloc step passed. looks like the default_batch bump is the culprit.

maria: confirming local reproduce when batch=2. i'll open an urgent revert for the config change and pin smoke.yaml to batch=1 while we investigate.

brian: sounds good. quick follow-up: we should add a preflight check to ensure smoke uses constrained memory to avoid CI-wide OOM regressions. filing an issue.

maria: created revert PR 9101 and a follow-up issue #1342 for preflight checks. tagging ops to coordinate any rollback of downstream deploys. :pray:

jake: re-run of the main pipeline after reverting config is queued. if it turns green i'll mark this resolved.

ci-bot: rerun of pipeline 9087 (post-revert) completed: ALL STEPS GREEN.

oncall-bot: main pipeline returned to green at 1795552580.

maria: thanks everyone. plan: merge revert, follow-up for guard, and postmortem note in #postmortems tomorrow.
